items.quote: How to not make the client bored or overwhelmed? Ask him questions relative to what your discussion, what you're talking about.
items.statement: Ask questions relative to the discussion to keep clients engaged and informed.

items.quote: A lot of real estate sales trainer is going to tell you, oh, build the report, don't talk about project, don't talk about sale for the first five minutes.
items.statement: Building rapport should not take precedence over discussing sales and projects during initial conversations.

items.quote: if you are curious, it gives him a signal again. It's all unconscious human behavior to respond.
items.statement: Use a curious tone when asking questions to foster engagement from clients.

items.quote: he's more engaging in the conversation because you are more interested to talk to human who are interested about you.
items.statement: Clients are more likely to engage in conversation when they feel the other person is genuinely interested in them.

items.quote: So, what is curiosity mean for you? Are you a curious person actually?
items.statement: The speaker emphasizes the importance of curiosity in client interactions.

items.quote: we have to be precise with the current clients, they don't have time, they understand what we are doing.
items.statement: Be precise with clients about sales instead of wasting time on small talk, as they typically understand the business context.

overview: This source chunk discusses strategies for client engagement in sales, particularly in real estate, with a focus on asking questions appropriately and maintaining client interest.
